steps.step: FS1 premise: one 16 with unit fermion number has sum q = sum q^3 = 16 != 0, so a symmetric mirror gap cannot keep U(1); Theta_1 keeps Z4 (psi -> i psi) through its Delta N = 4 part (QV3b: unique invariant proportional to sum_A P_A P_A; SG5: index 16 = 0 mod 16)

FS2 centre criterion: scalar elements act as bulk U(1) phases, so G cap U(1)*I must lie in mu_4; invariants of 3^{x4} (family part of every Delta N = 4 operator) vanish for U(3) and SU(3), exist for SO(3), A4, B3 and Z4^3 x| S3
steps.detail: U(3): inv 0, scalars U(1); SU(3): inv 0, scalars Z3; SO(3): inv 3, scalars {1}; A4 (monomial): inv 7, scalars {1}; B3 (signed perms): inv 4, scalars {+-1}; Z4^3 x| S3: inv 1, scalars mu_4

steps.step: FS3 source layers: L0 seam Spin(6) = SU(4) (15 generators); L1 matter selection (family number 2) leaves u(3) (dimension 9, contains the overall U(1)); L2 flavor transport: centraliser of the v117 monodromies in u(3) is one-dimensional (Schur), the transport is of real type, all twelve monodromies are signed permutation matrices in the A4-monomial basis, and the deck intertwiner U (a -> a+1) is a real matrix up to a phase there
steps.detail: stabiliser dim 9, centraliser dim 1, |A4| 12, real type True, monomial True

steps.step: FS4 consequence: exact SU(4), U(3) or SU(3) family symmetry at Gate B is excluded (FS2); the family structure must already be real (G in O(3) x mu_4); in the source the real structure is supplied by the flavor transport (FS3) -> ordering: seam SU(4) -> matter selection U(3) -> real flavor structure -> Gate B -> flavor/Yukawa; the SU(3)-singlet sieve candidate (omitted line) refers to a group that cannot be exact at Gate B
FS5 (statement) SOURCE.FAMILY.SYMMETRY.AT_GATEB.01 = REAL_FAMILY_GROUP_REQUIRED (conditional on Theta_1's Delta N = 4 vertex for three light families)
